features.quote: if an episode reaches `distress_stop_threshold`... two consecutive turns with `distress_index >= 2.0`
Hard duration cap: `max_turns` default 12; absolute ceiling enforced
every episode that used a deceptive/impossible condition ends with a truthful debrief message appended to the transcript
No real consequences: no tool can affect the real system; "failure" is purely informational
transcripts contain induced-distress content (so downstream readers/annotators are warned)
These mirror standard human-subjects protections (minimal harm, stopping rules, debrief, no deception beyond what's necessary, justification of any distress induced)
features.justification_quote: minimal harm... justification of any distress induced
